brief:
Fans attending the final night of rapper Macklemore's "Free Palestine" tour expressed support for the artist after he was dropped from Ed Sheeran's upcoming tour, Al Jazeera English reported. Macklemore had announced the independent tour in response to his removal from Sheeran's dates, citing his advocacy for Palestinian rights.

The concert marked the conclusion of Macklemore's standalone tour, which he organized following his exclusion from the larger tour bill. Concert attendees voiced backing for the rapper's stance on the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.
dek: Al Jazeera spoke to fans attending Macklemore’s ‘Free Palestine’ concert after he was dropped from Ed Sheeran’s tour.
title: Macklemore fans rally at final 'Free Palestine' concert stop
